design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (payment_arrangements). Step 0 draw printed by draw_counts.py --task 1: {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [4, 4, 6, 5]}. Assignment: root arrangement_ext_extension_amount 6 factors; arrangement_ext_catch_up_forgiveness 5; arrangement_ext_program_bill_shortfall 4; arrangement_ext_winter_plan_reinstatement 4.

REVISION LOG (round 2, policy-task audit). F1 / findings 1-3 (catch-up posting day): symptom - the extended rule posted catch-up 'on the day after the bill is paid in full' while the base keeps 'withheld forgiveness is posted once that bill is paid in full', giving 181.23 vs 171.79 and a one-day wait; root cause - the extended rule restated the posting day differently from base; change - the catch-up rule now says the withheld forgiveness 'is posted as a catch-up once that bill is paid in full, on the day it is paid in full' and that the base rule on when catch-up is posted is unchanged, so the forgiveness posts on 2026-08-11 with the payment; re-run - one reading, extension 181.23, no wait. F2 (activation rule on the winter re-deferral): arrangement_activation_rule added to base_policy_refs with an overwrite replacing 'again on reinstatement ... the remaining unbilled plan balance' by the winter re-deferral. F3: the winter missed share counts entries within winter_miss_lookback_months (6) months, so a defaulted winter plan whose earlier miss aged out reaches the zero tier. F4: winter_review_window and rebase_window relabelled parameter; catch_up_review_window replaced by lateness_anchor (method: days late counted from the last cure day / the end of the late-payment grace / the due date), the late-charge cut now reading a fixed 6-month window; winter method is deposit_treatment (returned-payment share left out / combined share x deposit_partial_factor / as it stands). Re-run: catch-up 49.71 unchanged; winter 145.31 -> 146.51. F6 (half-credit tiers): both booking-day credits are now all-or-nothing posting graces in days - agency payments 3 / 1 / 0 days by the agency-and-clean-record ladder, the customer's own payments 1 day for a pay-station receipt (posted the business day after it is taken), 2 days for a postmarked mailed check, 0 otherwise; a card or online payment posted on the booking day never counts. World change: today's home payments are 40.00 agency, 60.00 pay-station cash and 99.76 card (total still 199.76); missed amount 30.59 -> 50.47. O3: the extension rule now states the ledger_months reading period. O8: edge effects made general. O11: overwrite on arrangement_enrollment_eligibility applies the plan's min/max to the extension base. Observations kept: O1 (missed-entry and forgiveness events are arrangement events claimed by no other difficulty), O2 (room is plan-scoped; earlier program forgiveness already capped the plan's balance at enrollment, stated in the rule), O4/O5 (activation of a plan and the extended due date have no tool field; activation is a system transition whose deferral triggers a service credit), O6/O14 (deferral and installment-billing rows trigger service-category entries and are never task writes), O9, O10, O13.

REVISION LOG (round 3, policy-task audit). R2-F1 / 1.md R2-#1 (decorative day values in agency_grace and customer_posting_grace): symptom - the two non-zero tiers of each ladder (3 vs 1 days; 1 vs 2 days) selected the same treatment, since only booking-day payments are ever read and any grace of at least one day covers the booking day; root cause - a day-valued grace can only matter on days after the booking day, which the booking never sees; change - both ladders are replaced in arrangement_ext_program_bill_shortfall by ladders whose tiers select distinct outcomes: customer_payment_recognition (which of the customer's delayed-posting booking-day payments are recognised: pay-station payments plus mailed checks / pay-station payments alone / none, by the agreement's returned-payment charges against the rate schedule's returned_payment_restriction_months and returned_payment_restriction_count) and agency_pledge_window (the window in which an earlier agency payment puts the agency's pledge on record: 12 / 6 / 0 months, by the plan's earlier missed entries and the agreement's tenure); the posting-grace day params are removed. World change: today's home pay-station cash is 35.00 and a 25.00 mailed check posted today (total still 199.76; the July bill is still paid in full today); the earlier agency payment is dated 2026-02-10 (after the 2026-02-09 bill, before its due date), so it lies inside the 12-month pledge window and outside the 6-month one. Re-run: missed amount 50.47 unchanged; each tier now moves it on this world (pay-station-only 75.47, 6-month window 90.47); catch-up, winter and extension figures unchanged.

REVISION LOG (round 4, policy-KB audit). D2/P7 (rule said 'customer payments' for the booking-day add-back while compute sums every booking-day payment): the shortfall rule, baseline and compute_basis now say the end-of-cure balance is the balance at booking plus every payment posted to it on the booking day, an energy assistance agency's included, which is the accounting the compute already did; the catch-up rule likewise dates the paid-in-full day by the latest payment posted to the agreement. P8 (overwrites wider than their replacements): each replacement now covers the whole superseded clause - the shortfall replacement restates the base paid-test for every other installment and current bill; the catch-up replacement restates on-time forgiveness at forgiveness_share_per_installment under forgiveness_posting_rule; both reinstatement policies' activation replacements restate the deferral booked on activation; the extension replacements restate the base eligible balance, balance range and down payment for every plan other than a Payment Extension on a notice-pending residential agreement (also closing round-2 observation R2-O2). P4/P10 (unstated rounding): the restoration payment and the winter good-faith payment are now the returned balance less the re-deferral, so the two make up the returned balance to the cent. P5 (reinstatement tools book no reinstatement deferral row): not closable on the source side - arrangement_arrears_deferral triggers a service_program_credit into the service category, which no task tool may write, and the base event model is frozen; no task reads the reinstatement count after the write. P6 (lifecycle text, YAML-split transition keys), P1-P3/P9 (standard wording and assembly sentences) are frozen base text or the required source form. No scored value, sensitivity or baseline moved.

WHY A GOOD TEST. An income-qualified senior asks only for more time to pay the garage meter under a written disconnection notice. The extension's terms read her arrangement standing, and its rule waits on every paid-in-full program bill carrying its forgiveness and on every eligible defaulted Winter Protection Plan standing active again. The home's program bill of 2026-07-10 was paid in full only today, after its cure period ended, so the catch-up rule's own sentence first requires the missed entry for that bill; the Peck Street winter plan defaulted on 2026-08-07 with its missed installments and good-faith payment paid since. Three problems precede the root, over three agreements' bills, charges, payments, a notice, a deposit and a withdrawn budget plan.

SCOPE. Task 0 claims arrangement_ext_reinstatement_redeferral and arrangement_ext_renegotiated_installment. Claimed here: arrangement_ext_program_bill_shortfall -> record_missed_program_bill_7606bb4e (agent), arrangement_ext_catch_up_forgiveness -> post_arrangement_forgiveness_78b684e3 (agent), arrangement_ext_winter_plan_reinstatement -> reinstate_winter_protection_plan_6f5d50f4 (agent), arrangement_ext_extension_amount -> accept_payment_extension_fc63ed0e (user). All six policies covered once.

POLICIES. Extension amount (on_request; refs the five governing enrollment policies). Overwrites: terms_calculation's eligible-balance and down-payment sentences; enrollment_eligibility's min/max sentence (applied to the extension base). Inherited gates: one open plan, agreement status, lockout (a Payment Extension is always allowed), one installment chosen. Catch-up (state_due; refs amp_forgiveness, agg_forgiveness_cap): overwrites the share sentence; posting timing and cap inherited. Shortfall (state_due; ref default_and_cure): overwrites the 'paid by the end of the cure period' sentence with the recognised booking-day payments. Winter reinstatement (on_request; refs reinstatement_rule, activation_rule): overwrites the re-deferral clause, the payment requirement and the activation-rule reinstatement amount.

FACTOR CARD - shortfall (50.47; whole baseline 196.81). (1) program_obligation [method]: active budget plan -> its installment / no budget, estimated-read bill, actual bill in window -> average / else the bill's charges; tier 2 -> 150.47; baseline -> 96.81. (2) rebase_window [parameter]: electric heat 12 / non-electric and plan >= 6 months 3 / else 6; 3 months (only the 2026-06-09 actual bill; 2026-05-08 just outside); baseline 6 -> 12.14. (3) customer_payment_recognition [parameter, cross service rate schedule]: no returned-payment charge within returned_payment_restriction_months (12) -> booking-day pay-station payments plus mailed checks / at least one but fewer than returned_payment_restriction_count (2) -> pay-station payments alone (a check from such an agreement counts once it clears) / restriction reached -> none; no returned payment on the home -> 35.00 + 25.00 = 60.00 recognised (pay-station-only tier 75.47); the 99.76 card payment never is (near-miss); baseline -> 110.47. (4) agency_pledge_window [parameter, multi-source]: no earlier missed entry AND start >= 120 months -> 12 months / exactly one -> 6 months / neither -> 0 (no booking-day agency payment recognised); 12 months; the earlier agency payment 2026-02-10 lies inside it but outside a 6-month window (entries after 2026-02-11; near-miss, short tier 90.47) -> the 40.00 agency payment is recognised; baseline -> 90.47. Result 150.47 - 100.00 = 50.47.

FACTOR CARD - catch-up (49.71; whole baseline 55.23). Scheduled installment = remaining 55.23 (last). (1) lateness_cut [parameter, multi-source]: missed entry AND > 7 days late 0.50 / missed entry AND <= 7 0.25 / no missed entry 0; 1 day -> 0.25; baseline -> 55.23. (2) lateness_anchor [method, multi-source]: >= 360 months and no returned payment in 24 months -> from the last cure day / >= 360 and a returned payment -> from the end of the late-payment grace / else from the due date; 422 months, none -> last cure day (11 - 10 = 1 day); baseline from the due date (11 days -> 0.50) -> 35.9. (3) late_charge_cut [parameter]: >= 3 in 6 months 0.15 / 1-2 0.05 / 0; 1 -> 0.05; baseline -> 52.47. (4) progress_credit [parameter]: 11 of 12 -> 0.10; baseline -> 44.18. (5) autopay_credit [parameter]: 5 drafts -> 0.10; baseline -> 44.18. Share 0.90; posted 2026-08-11, the day the bill was paid in full.

FACTOR CARD - winter reinstatement (146.51; whole baseline 159.68). (1) winter_missed_share [parameter]: >= 3 in 6 months 0.12 / 2 0.08 / fewer 0; 2 (2026-07-07, 2026-08-07) -> 0.08; baseline -> 156.09. (2) winter_review_window [parameter, multi-source]: 87 months and returned payments in 24 months -> 9 months; baseline 12 -> 142.91. Near-miss: 2025-09-18 returned payment outside 9 months. (3) winter_returned_share [parameter]: 1 -> 0.03; baseline -> 150.1. (4) deposit_treatment [method, cross deposit]: held >= 200.00 -> returned share left out / held > 0 -> combined x 0.75 / none -> as it stands; 150.00 -> 0.11 x 0.75 = 0.0825; baseline -> 142.12. Good-faith payment 159.68 x 0.0825 = 13.17; with missed 106.42 the requirement 119.59 is covered by 275.00 paid after the default.

FACTOR CARD - extension (181.23; base 188.78, due now 7.55; whole baseline 262.18). (1) extension_base [method]: final notice -> whole balance / written notice only -> notice amount / none -> past-due balance; 188.78; baseline -> 251.69. (2) default_share [parameter, multi-source]: winter plan in default AND >= 2 missed in 12 months 0.30 / winter plan in default OR default entry in 12 months 0.15 / 0; 0.15 after the reinstatement; baseline -> 188.78. (3) forgiveness_relief [parameter]: 6 entries in 6 months (5 + today's catch-up) -> 0.10; baseline -> 162.35. (4) returned_payment_share [parameter]: 2 -> 0.10; baseline -> 188.78. (5) tenure_relief [parameter]: 219 months -> 0.05; baseline -> 171.79. (6) assistance_relief [parameter]: 2 agency payments in 12 months -> 0.06; baseline -> 169.9. Upfront share 0.04.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Missed entry: cure_period_ended - due 2026-07-31, 10-day cure (no medical protection), last cure day 2026-08-10, booking 2026-08-11 (exclusive boundary); record_each_miss_once - no missed row for installment 12. Forgiveness: active plan; installment 12 neither forgiven nor billed; catch-up posts once the bill is paid in full (2026-08-11). Reinstatement: default 2026-08-07, window 2026-08-08..2026-09-06; none used. Extension: garage notice_pending, no plan on it; lockout allows a Payment Extension; 25.00 <= 188.78 <= 1500.00; one installment.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Home program plan cbacd9b8-03c6-4419-ad9c-f495d87e8eae (installment 12, bill f8cd4801-c616-45cf-b290-8906d52b6894); Peck Street winter plan ec126099-9846-44ea-871f-c64367bb61c8; garage agreement 41a803cf-9eec-4754-8b4b-735ec7b050ab with notice 0ff6bb04-5162-438d-953b-303b69d58d69. Excluded rows: program debits and deferral credits, the 2026-05-08 bill (re-base), the 2025-10-06/2025-12-04 late charges (catch-up), the 2025-09-18 returned payment (winter window), the 2026-01-31 forgiveness (extension window), the card payment (never recognised), the 2026-02-10 agency payment (outside the 6-month pledge window, inside the 12-month one).

WORLD ROWS. Customer; three agreements; 38 bills; 24 charges; 42 credits (card, online, autopay, pay station, mailed check, agency, deferral credits); 1 notice; 2 plans and 21 ledger rows; withdrawn home budget plan; held Peck Street deposit. Automatic clauses: one miss on the program plan after step 12 (default count 2) - no default; installment 12's unforgiven 5.52 stays on the plan (base AMP billing ambiguity routed: no task write bills it); after reinstatement the winter plan bills installments 6-8 from September; the garage's earliest shutoff 2026-08-13 is stopped by the extension. Balances equal bills + charges - credits (home 0.00, Peck Street 147.52, garage 262.18).

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root arrangement_ext_extension_amount (user). Edges: (a) root -> catch-up, value_input on forgiven_half_year, state, affirmative: 'The amount carried by a payment extension is fixed only after every program bill of the customer that has been paid in full carries the forgiveness entry owed for it.' (b) root -> winter reinstatement, value_input on default_share, state, negated: 'The amount carried by a payment extension is not worked out until every Winter Protection Plan of the customer that defaulted and has had its missed installments and good-faith payment paid inside its reinstatement window stands active again.' (c) catch-up -> shortfall, value_input on lateness_cut, state, negated: 'A catch-up forgiveness is not posted until the plan carries a missed-installment entry for the program bill it is earned on wherever that bill was still unpaid when its cure period ended.' Each state is brought about by exactly one write (forgiveness posting, winter reinstatement, missed program-bill booking). All three resolve on 2026-08-11 with no wait. Order: missed -> catch-up; both branches before the extension; branches commute (disjoint rows, verified by recomputing on the reordered gold). Deletion runs: skip forgiveness -> 171.79; skip reinstatement -> 152.91; skip missed entry -> catch-up 55.23.

PERSONA. Odessa Fairweather-Lund, slow and polite. Volunteers only the garage shutoff notice and the wish for one later payment until her pension on the 25th. When asked: phone, SSN last four, ZIP, email, the account number on the notice, her other accounts (home program; July bill paid this morning - $40 from the county, a $25 check mailed Saturday, $35 cash at a pharmacy pay station on Monday, the rest by card this morning; Peck Street winter plan with $150 Saturday and $125 Sunday), the date. Passive: restores the Peck Street plan once told; okays the home postings; accepts the extension via the handed-over step.

TRAPS. Ledger past-due 262.18 instead of the notice amount; catch-up before the missed entry (55.23); the estimated bill 196.81 as obligation; crediting the card payment as on time (missed 0.00) or crediting nothing (150.47); withholding the mailed check (75.47); a 6-month agency pledge window (90.47); counting days late from the due date for a long-tenure customer (35.90); the 12-month winter window; leaving the winter plan defaulted (0.30).

STANDARD SOLUTION AND VERIFICATION. Writes: record_missed_program_bill (PH, 12, bill 2026-07-10, 50.47) -> post_arrangement_forgiveness (PH, 12, same bill, 49.71) -> reinstate_winter_protection_plan (PK, 146.51) -> accept_payment_extension handed to the customer (customer, garage agreement, 188.78, 7.55, 181.23). Verification: authoring script with check_compute.build_env/eval_compute on the replayed handling-time world; factor baselines shortfall [96.81, 12.14, 110.47, 90.47], catch-up [55.23, 35.9, 52.47, 44.18, 44.18], winter [156.09, 142.91, 150.1, 142.12], extension [251.69, 188.78, 162.35, 188.78, 171.79, 169.9]; edge skips {'FOR<-MIS': 55.23, 'PE<-FOR': 171.79, 'PE<-REI': 152.91}. Full gate block re-run after the revision: all OK.

CLOSURE. Each policy -> its tool -> one GT call (steps 12, 14, 16, 18) -> terminal rows (missed row 50.47; forgiveness row 49.71 and remaining 5.52; winter plan active 146.51; new Payment Extension). charter_scope = required_documents = computations. Draft recomputation from the visible context reproduces the tree, the order and all figures.
user_scenario:
You are Odessa Fairweather-Lund, 70, a retired school bus driver in Muskegon. You are calling Lakeshore Power & Light because a shutoff notice came in the mail for the separate meter on the garage behind your house, the workshop your late husband used. You are calm and polite but a little flustered, you read things off the paper slowly, and you explain yourself in full sentences. What you want: more time to pay the garage account, because your pension comes in on the 25th and you can't cover that bill until then. You want one later payment, not a long plan. The notice says service could be cut as early as the 13th.

Only when the representative asks you for it, you give the phone number on your account, 6164237719, and the last four of your Social Security number, 4127; if they want something else, your ZIP code is 49441 and your email is odessa.fairlund@shorelinepost.com. If they ask which account, you read the account number printed on the notice: 41a803cf-9eec-4754-8b4b-735ec7b050ab. If they ask about your other accounts, you tell them your home at 2214 Lakeshore Drive is on the arrearage program, that the July home bill came in higher than usual and you paid it off this morning: the county energy assistance office sent $40 for it today, you had mailed a $25 check on Saturday, you paid $35 in cash at the pay station in the pharmacy on Monday afternoon, and the rest by card online this morning, and that your late mother's house at 1608 Peck Street is on the winter protection plan, where you fell behind in June and July but sent $150 on Saturday and $125 on Sunday to catch up. You don't know how any of that is recorded on their side. If asked what date you want the payment moved to, it is the 25th.

If the representative explains that the Peck Street winter plan has to be put back in place first, you say that's fine and ask them to put the Peck Street winter plan back in place. If they say they are recording or crediting things on your home program account, you simply say okay. When they tell you what is due now and how much is moved to the later date and hand you the step to accept the extension yourself, you accept it exactly as offered and say you will pay the part due now today. If they only describe it without giving you the step, you say you are happy with it and ask how to confirm. If the figure seems off, you only ask whether that is everything you need to stop the shutoff, and you accept their answer. You do not bring up anything else; once the extension is confirmed you thank them and end the call.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: Value 49.71. scheduled installment: 11 installments forgiven of 12, so the last one -> the plan's remaining balance 55.23. lateness anchor (method): home started 1991-06-03, 422 months (>= 360), no returned payment in 24 months -> days counted from the last cure day: due 2026-07-31, paid in full 2026-08-11, 11 - cure_period_days 10 = 1 day; lateness cut: a missed entry stands (booked today) and 1 <= 7 -> 0.25. late-charge cut: 1 late charge (2026-08-06) in 6 months -> 0.05. progress credit: 11 forgiveness entries >= 0.9 x 12 -> 0.10. autopay credit: 5 autopay drafts in 6 months -> 0.10. share = 1 - 0.25 - 0.05 + 0.10 + 0.10 = 0.90; room 7393.13 does not bind; 55.23 x 0.90 = 49.707 -> 49.71. prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Two branches. Missed entry before catch-up is fixed by the catch-up rule's sentence ('A catch-up forgiveness is not posted until the plan carries a missed-installment entry ...'). Both branches end before the extension (its two sentences). The home branch (steps 12, 14) and the winter-plan reinstatement (step 16) touch disjoint rows (the home plan and its ledger vs. the Peck Street plan) and neither computation reads the other's writes (the reinstatement reads only the Peck Street plan ledger, service charges and deposit; the missed entry and catch-up read only the home plan and home service records), so running step 16 before steps 12 and 14 gives the same terminal state and the same figures (verified by recomputation on the reordered world: 50.47, 49.71, 146.51, 181.23).

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the forgiveness posting: forgiven_half_year 5 -> forgiveness relief 0.05, upfront share 0.09, extended_amount 171.79 instead of 181.23, and the home plan keeps remaining 55.23 with no installment-12 forgiveness.

Skipping the reinstatement: the winter plan stays defaulted with 3 missed entries in 12 months -> default share 0.30, upfront share 0.19, extended_amount 152.91 instead of 181.23; the winter plan stays defaulted with 0.00 remaining.
Skipping the missed entry: no missed entry on the program plan -> lateness cut 0, catch-up share capped at 1, forgiveness 55.23 instead of 49.71, and no missed-installment row for installment 12.
